flagged.title: Communicating Design Ideas
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly claims that all parallel lines in isometric drawing are drawn at 30 degrees to the horizontal rather than specifying that vertical lines remain vertical and only horizontal edges are drawn at 30 degrees, which would lose marks on a GCSE Design & Technology exam.

mark_affecting.quote: All the parallel lines stay parallel, and they're drawn at exactly 30 degrees to the horizontal.
